description: Global shortcut, the updater and the desktop notification plugin are desktop only. `tauri-plugin-updater` declares `ios: none, android: none`, and mobile updates ship through TestFlight and Play, so a mobile build must not see this permission — which is why it is here rather than in `default.json`. The notification permission is here for the same shape of reason: the desktop plugin is the official `tauri-plugin-notification`, and its mobile counterpart is the community crate whose permission is `notifications:default` in `mobile.json` (A310).
